lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li3Mn2O4 (Li6Mn4O8 per cell) adopts orthorhombic Pnma (No. 62), with 18 atoms and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Li centers with 4 O neighbors and Mn centers with 6 O neighbors, while O centers have 3–4 geometric neighbors (1 Li, 3 Mn). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between 6-vertex Mn and 4-vertex Li polyhedra and edge-sharing between 6-vertex Mn polyhedra.
